about_the_game:
Homelander’s Valor is a roguelite Tower Defense strategy game with tactical control over your hero and units. Build defenses, lead your troops, and survive the day-night cycle in a world shaped by the legends of the Silk Road—where every choice can turn the tide of battle.

  • Each day, you explore, gather resources, recruit warriors, and create your own bastion. 

  • At night, you fend off enemy waves from two flanks while controlling your hero in real time.

  • The loop is simple: prepare by day — survive by night.

  • Every tower evolves along a tech tree: first, choose its attack type — catapult, ballista, archer, and more.

  • Then, enhance it with a unique effect like fire, poison, fear, or stun.

  • This system isn’t just about raw power — it’s about giving each tower a distinct tactical role in your defense.

  • You choose where to build — and take full responsibility for the outcome. 

  • No fixed build points: place towers, barricades, and workshops anywhere on the level.

  • Your defense takes shape based on enemy direction and your chosen tactics.

  • Each run becomes a custom strategic build with total control in your hands.

  • Real-time control — without the chaos.

  • The minimap is an active tool that shows wave directions, unit positions, and flank status.

  • Use it to respond quickly: reposition your hero, reassign troops, and make split-second decisions that shape the outcome of each battle.

  • A world inspired by Eastern myths — no magic, only relics, symbols of power, and enemies driven by darkness.

  • Here, the hero isn’t the chosen one — he’s the last one left standing.

  • You’re not defending a base. You’re protecting a banner, your honor, and those who still stand behind you.
